headlines.title: UK lost more than it gained from Brexit, Burnham to say ahead of EU summit
headlines.description: The prime minister will say the "Brexit we were given has not worked" in a speech on Monday.

headlines.title: Intel sued by investors after PC sales slump hits share price
headlines.description: A proposed class action claims the firm hid the impact of slowing PC sales from shareholders.

headlines.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
headlines.description: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.

headlines.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy
headlines.description: Huang abruptly quit on Thursday as head of one of the world's most valuable companies after revelations of alleged extramarital affairs.

headlines.title: UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years
headlines.description: ﻿The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September, according to official figures.
